statements.status_notes: The advisory is a panic in serde_with's KeyValueMap adapter on empty sequence/map entries. The qdrant binary in this image is installed from the dhi/pkg-qdrant package (built with `cargo auditable build --release --locked --bin qdrant --features stacktrace`). qdrant uses serde_with in a single module (src/common/update.rs) and does not use the KeyValueMap adapter anywhere in the source (zero references), so the vulnerable code path is never instantiated.
